The ideal candidate will have experience advising businesses on privacy, data protection, and/or cybersecurity matters . cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:95.description: Our client is a premier utility company specializing in rapid response and storm chasing to utility companies and contractors in need of a quick reaction force to repair power outages when they need it most. With a commitment to excellence and innovation, we provide reliable and efficient solutions to help our clients restore power quickly and effectively during emergencies and adverse weather conditions while ensuring operational efficiency and financial sustainability. Our customers are our communities, and when they need us, we are there. We are seeking a skilled and experienced Fleet Mechanic to maintain our fleet maintenance while supporting our rapid response and restoration services. The Fleet Operations Lead Mechanic will play a critical role in the upkept and readiness of our fleet of vehicles, equipment, and assets to ensure optimal performance, safety, and efficiency. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in commercial vehicle maintenance and maintenance schedules.
responsibilities: Fleet Maintenance:
Regularly review preventative maintenance schedules and ensure all vehicles are being maintained according to schedule
Diagnoses minor mechanical and electronic problems, utilizing diagnostic computer when applicable
Addresses all identified maintenance needs in an efficient manner while ensuring compliance with maintenance reporting requirements
Oversees and leads the emergency response maintenance and repairs as needed
Asset Availability & Utilization:
Ensure repairs are efficiently addressed to maintain asset availability for projects, jobs, and emergency responses.
Analyze asset data to identify opportunities for optimization, including right-sizing the fleet, improving asset utilization, and minimizing downtime.
Assist in developing preventive maintenance schedules and programs to extend the lifespan of fleet assets and reduce maintenance costs.
Equipment Safety and Compliance:
Assist in enforcing safety policies and procedures to ensure the safe operation of fleet vehicles and equipment.
Participate in regular safety training and inspections, addressing any safety concerns or violations promptly.
Assist in ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, including vehicle inspections, emissions testing, and driver licensing.
Emergency Response Support:
Assist in deploying fleet assets and personnel rapidly in response to emergencies and power outages.
Assist to ensure the readiness and availability of fleet resources during emergency situations.
Oversees and efficiently utilizes emergency mechanical support to ensure any mechanical opportunities are effectively addressed.
qualifications: Certifications in commercial fleet maintenance, as well as a minimum of 5 years proven fleet maintenance experience.
Strong knowledge of vehicle maintenance schedules, hands-on experience in diesel engine and/or heavy vehicle maintenance, diagnosis, repair, and safety compliance.
Excellent communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
CDL - plus inspection and emission license required

flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.title: Executive Assistant
flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.description: Flagship Pioneering is a bioplatform innovation company that invents and builds platform companies that change the world. We bring together the greatest scientific minds with entrepreneurial company builders and assemble the capital to allow them to take courageous leaps. Those big leaps in human health and sustainability exponentially accelerate scientific progress in areas ranging from cancer detection and treatment to nature-positive agriculture. What sets Flagship apart is our ability to advance biotechnology by uniting life science innovation, company creation, and capital investment under one roof in a way that is largely without precedent. Our scientific founders, entrepreneurial leaders, and professional capital managers are each aligned around an institutionalized process that enables us to innovate and transform for the benefit of people and planet. Many of the companies Flagship has founded have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture. Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies, and has been twice named to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. The position engages primarily with external Flagship stakeholders and plays a key role in supporting Flagship’s partnering efforts across the pharmaceutical ecosystem. jobgether-jobgether:lever:32c7285d-4c42-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Clinical Quality Lead based in the United States. This is a fully remote clinical leadership opportunity focused on building a scalable quality system for home-based specialty pharmacy and infusion care. You will define clinical standards, quality indicators, investigation frameworks, and escalation pathways that support safe independent nursing practice. The role combines clinical judgment, patient safety, incident management, education, and continuous improvement. You will investigate adverse events and near misses, identify root causes, and translate findings into practical corrective actions. Working cross-functionally, you will influence clinical education, product development, analytics, compliance, and pharmacy partner relationships. This is an opportunity to shape quality practices across a rapidly scaling, multi-state healthcare environment. The role is ideal for an experienced nurse who thrives on autonomy, precision, systems thinking, and meaningful clinical impact. Define and maintain clinical standards for home visits, including medication administration, infusion practices, patient assessment, monitoring, escalation, and documentation. Develop clinical review criteria, decision frameworks, quality indicators, and escalation pathways that support independent nurses operating across multiple markets and care programs. Own the investigation and resolution of medication errors, adverse events, near misses, and other clinical quality incidents. Conduct root cause analyses and CAPA processes using a fair, clinically sound, and systems-oriented approach, distinguishing individual performance issues from workflow, education, product, or partner-related factors. Determine appropriate corrective actions, including nurse education, competency reassessment, marketplace restrictions, or leadership escalation. Produce clear, accurate, balanced, and defensible investigation findings for nurses, pharmacy partners, and internal leadership. Translate quality findings into clinical education priorities, competency expectations, job aids, communications, policies, and SOPs. Develop and maintain clinical policies, documentation standards, and investigation procedures while measuring whether interventions improve nursing practice. Serve as the clinical quality subject matter expert during pharmacy partner quality reviews, investigations, and performance discussions. Collaborate with Product, Analytics, Compliance, and operational teams to incorporate clinical requirements, risk considerations, and quality insights into broader initiatives. Build repeatable quality playbooks that can support expansion into new states, partnerships, therapies, and clinical programs. Continuously identify opportunities to improve patient safety, nursing performance, operational consistency, and the overall quality framework. Requirements: Active, unencumbered Registered Nurse (RN) license. At least 5 years of nursing experience, including 3+ years in clinical quality, patient safety, risk management, clinical education, documentation review, or a closely related area. Direct experience conducting clinical incident investigations using root cause analysis and CAPA methodologies. Strong knowledge of nursing standards of practice, medication administration safety, clinical documentation, and appropriate clinical escalation. Exceptional written communication skills, with the ability to produce precise, balanced, and defensible findings, standards, and clinical guidance. Strong clinical judgment and the ability to determine when an issue requires education, system redesign, escalation, or restriction from clinical activity. Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and make sound decisions in a remote, fast-paced, and evolving environment. jobgether-jobgether:lever:98495ab4-667f-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Databricks Data Security Engineer based in the United States. This role will lead the security architecture and implementation of access controls across a modern Databricks Lakehouse environment. You will serve as the senior technical owner for data access governance, translating security and compliance requirements into scalable controls. The position combines hands-on software engineering with architecture, automation, governance, and technical leadership. You will work closely with data engineering, platform engineering, identity teams, and enterprise stakeholders to establish secure data practices. Your work will shape how sensitive data is classified, accessed, monitored, and protected across the platform. The environment emphasizes infrastructure-as-code, automated security controls, and modern identity and federation patterns. This is an opportunity to build and mature a critical data security function while solving complex challenges at enterprise scale. Lead the architecture and implementation of role-based access control (RBAC) and attribute-based access control (ABAC) within Databricks Unity Catalog. Define scalable data access models, including data structures, permissions, tagging standards, dynamic views, row-level security, and column-level masking. Establish and evolve identity governance for the Databricks environment, including service principals, workload identities, SCIM, and integration with enterprise identity providers. Translate regulatory, contractual, security, and compliance requirements into practical technical controls and enforceable platform policies. Develop and maintain data classification frameworks and tagging structures that enable consistent and scalable access governance. Implement Databricks grants, catalogs, tags, access controls, and policies as code using Terraform and/or Databricks Asset Bundles. Build automation and controls that support version management, audit readiness, repeatability, and secure deployment practices. Partner with workspace administrators and platform engineers to align workspace, compute, secrets, networking, and identity controls with the overall data security architecture. Create reusable guardrails, templates, and workflows that enable data engineering teams to manage access efficiently while maintaining strong security standards. skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:477e1011-46e9-4d5d.title: Senior/Lead User Acquisition
skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:477e1011-46e9-4d5d.description: [https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png] Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших. Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR. Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів. Зараз ми в пошуку Senior/Lead User Acquisition Manager. Які виклики чекають тебе: — Безпосередній вплив на процеси задля зростання своєї зони та можливість запуску нових каналів — Стати наставником для інших User Acquisition менеджерів та в перспективі залідити команду. — Запуск та масштабування різних каналів: Meta/ Google/ TikTok/ Snapchat/ X/ Quora, etc — Впровадження growth hacking стратегій та пошуку можливостей для стрімкого росту, а не на класичних схемах просування — Оцінка результатів ефективності кампаній. Моніторити не тільки ключові маркетингові метрики (CTR, CR, CPA, ROI і т.д.), але й дивитися нижче по воронці і коригувати свою стратегію, базуючись на даних — Дослідження конкурентів, аналіз їхніх рекламних каналів, матеріалів та підходів до залучення користувачів — Робота з креативною командою для створення якісних рекламних креативів, що конвертять. Будеш ставити завдання для креативної команди, приймати участь у брейнштормах і оцінювати результат роботи дизайнерів — Робота з продуктово-технічною командою для створення крутих воронок, що конвертять. Будемо досліджувати та покращувати user flow. Що для нас важливо: — Досвід роботи у маркетингу 4+ років; — Практичний досвід у розробці та реалізації рекламних кампаній у Facebook/Google Ads; — Розуміння маркетингових метрик, таких як CPM, CTR, CPC, CR, CPA, ROAS, ROI, LTV тощо та взаємозв’язки з фінансовими результатами компанії — Підхід до прийняття рішень на основі даних. Сильні аналітичні здібності, вміння аналізувати великі обсяги інформації та робити з неї висновки; Буде плюсом: — Досвід 2+ роки на менеджерських посадах; — Досвід роботи з Tik Tok Ads; У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації: - SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті — а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші. - Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Серед наших колег — кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки. - Ексклюзивна доменна освіта. Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір — від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інтенсивів про AI та професійних клубів з розробки, продакт-менеджменту тощо. - Вплив на системну допомогу Україні. Маємо благодійний фонд SKELAR foundation, який створили самі скеларівці — і завдяки кожному співробітнику втілюємо важливі соціальні проєкти. Наприклад, заснували перший у Європі акселератор для ветеранів https://veteranventure.skelar.tech/ і формуємо майданчик для підтримки ветеранів на рівні держави. - Екосистема для продуктивної роботи. Для скеларівців створені простори, які надихають на результат — з власним спортзалом, скеледромом, зеленими зонами Bali та бібліотеками. southparkcommons-meesho:lever:d4c4d777-d.title: Senior Manager - DAU Growth
southparkcommons-meesho:lever:d4c4d777-d.description: About the Team Meesho is the most downloaded e-commerce app in India. As part of the core Business and Product-Experience team, we are taking a massive leap from a purely transactional e-commerce platform to a destination for visual discovery and personal inspiration. We are building an inspiration feed inside the Meesho app, focused on look-based, trend-based, and highly personalized inspiration across major lifestyle categories like Fashion, Home, and Beauty. Our team holds the end-to-end responsibility to figure out the supply of engaging content, establish content partnerships, and solve complex discovery and ranking problems to scale daily active users (DAU). We focus on personal growth, high-impact innovation, and thinking 10x. About the Role As a Senior Manager for the Content Commerce team, you will be the driving force behind how millions of users organically discover trends and find personal inspiration on Meesho. This is a 0-to-1 charter where you will solve the dual challenge of Content Supply and Algorithmic Ranking/Discovery. You will own user engagement, DAU growth, and content-to-commerce conversion metrics by ensuring our feed surfaces highly relevant, visually stunning, and localized content.
